notes:
- **Colon-key matching:** `ownerOf` in `/home/user/holyagent/packages/runtime/src/cli/report.ts` has tried every colon, longest head first, since 841ef47. The example criterion with a colon already matches, so I changed no code.
  - **Likely cause:** the failed validation report keyed its line as `mise run verify:`, which is only the first part of the criterion text. A key that is a shorter prefix of a criterion is not an equal match, so I kept it rejected.
  - **New test:** it covers a colon criterion with a colon in the support, and a key cut at the first colon. It passes on the old code too, because the bug is not in the source. That makes the criterion "a test that fails on the old code" unattainable for this item.
- **Both-payloads check dropped:** a stdin that never closes cannot be told from an empty one without reading it. The "Got JSON on both stdin and --input" check and its test are gone, and the doc comments say so. Stdin is still the source when `--input` is absent. The close and accept report paths are unchanged.
- **Shared predicate:** `legacyFoldersWithState` in `legacy.ts` serves both the hook and the gatherers, through `convertibleFolders`. A holyclaude folder counts only if it has files under `intents/<folder>/`. A holycodex folder counts only if it has a non-dot `<folder>/...` path. A `.holyclaude/` with only `local/` and `state.json` now gives no hook notice and `NothingToMigrate`.
- **Path that is not a directory:** `listFiles` now treats ENOTDIR as no files, so a plain file named `.holyclaude` does not fail the session-start hook.
- **Conflicts once:** a record whose id is already in `.holyagent/` now yields one conflict, not that plus "file already exists". Note files that already exist still each get their own line.
- **Read-only ownership:** the holyclaude converter drops ownership paths on read-only roles. A non-portable owned path on such a role still appears in `scope` as "Owned path (not portable)".
- **Plugin dist:** `packages/integrations/claude/dist/scripts/holyagent.js` is stale until the root runs `mise run build`.
